summary: Keep resource-scoped syncs out of authoritative whole-catalog snapshots.
reason: A classes-only or camps-only sync omits the other entity kind by design. Recording it as a full snapshot made drift report every omitted entity as removed.
validated_outcome: PASS: focused whole-catalog eligibility regression, full Go tests, go vet, go build, 134/134 dogfood checks, verify-skill, strict PII audit, supply-chain scan, and publish validation passed.
findings_addressed: Greptile P1: resource-scoped syncs created false removals in drift
reapply_notes: An authoritative ICP snapshot requires both classes and camps and a non-truncated walk. Scoped or page-capped runs may record openings history and update the generic search cache, but must return run_id 0 and snapshot_recorded false.
